purpose: Build the first clean-room product slice: durable Artist/Song identity and exact version/artifact lineage that survives restart without current/approved aliasing or profile leakage.

lineage.outcome: A real Song can be created, left, reopened and resumed without identity or approval drift.
lineage.capability: Durable Song identity + exact version/artifact lineage

completion_proof: clean profile creates one Artist and one Song with stable opaque identities
a source asset can be attached with exact content identity
v1 and v2 preserve immutable ancestry and artifact linkage
CURRENT may be v2 while APPROVED remains v1 until explicit approval
close and reopen preserve identical Artist/Song/asset/version IDs and active Song
another profile cannot read or link the first profile's Song/assets
copied or corrupt durable state fails visibly rather than silently resetting
tests and stage smoke pass without DAW/provider dependencies
non_scope: full Artist Graph or universal search/activity
wholesale legacy code or test import
next_selection_rule: After CORE-01A proof, reconcile evidence and reselect from the whole N0TE hierarchy. Do not continue by storage-code adjacency.
